label: Soft tissue sarcoma

approval.note: Draft checklist from NCG Guidelines for Bone and Soft Tissue Tumours (2019) and the NCG Guidelines for Pediatric Haematolymphoid and Solid Tumours (2019): needs a clinician's check

site_note: V2 item 5.3 (two primaries): only on a Case File linked to the same patient's other Case File, and only for histopathology, cytology, IHC and molecular records: among several candidates for one record, or several documents carrying a required value, one that names another protocol's site and not this one steps aside and is named on the row for review; a document naming no site never does, and when every candidate names another site every candidate stays. Organ words only. A preference, never a filter; a patient with one cancer is checked as before.
note: DRAFT, not approved for real use: needs a clinician's check. Configurable by the clinical team. Required records transcribed from the NCG Guidelines for Bone and Soft Tissue Tumours (2019) (National Cancer Grid, India), the extremity soft tissue sarcoma pages (flow p 20 to 23, staging work-up p 26 and 27, pathology format p 41 to 43; the PDF page is the printed page), and, for rhabdomyosarcoma in a child, the NCG Guidelines for Pediatric Haematolymphoid and Solid Tumours (2019) (p 59, Annexure 1 p 64; PDF pages, the printed footer is one less; the heading of that page reads 'Treatment Algorithm: Neuroblastoma', a typing slip in the book). Each record has its verbatim quote and page; where both books give a record both are cited. Tiers printed by NCG are kept; the tiers whose tier_basis says 'proposed' are proposals, to be confirmed by the hospital Tumour Board (clinical review before real use). A record NCG gives only under a condition the system never judges (a finding, a plan) is shown with NCG's own tier and the condition, never counted. The stage and the risk group are as recorded by the clinician, never computed. Nothing here suggests treatment. The book has a flow for extremity soft tissue sarcoma only: retroperitoneal, trunk, head and neck and uterine sarcomas have none. The book's staging is TNM with grade and the surgico-pathologic grouping for rhabdomyosarcoma; it never names an AJCC edition. A child's treating team is Paediatric Oncology: clinical records go to the owner of the Case File.
settings_note: Setting of the Case File, chosen by the clinician from what the signed reports record (the system never computes stage and never decides the setting). The settings follow the book: 'Non-metastatic soft tissue sarcoma' and 'Metastatic soft tissue sarcoma' (p 20) and, for a child, 'Suspected Rhabdomyosarcoma' (paediatric book p 59). Each record carries its tier per setting; until a setting is recorded the strictest tier applies. Draft checklist: needs a clinician's check.
